cases.description: LEAP add-on with avg price — must emit long-dated expiry, not next Friday

input.message: Added to SPY Leaps - now 50 total contracts $38.97 avg

cases.notes: Classic LEAP case. LLM must emit a leg with long-dated expiry. Bug: old system defaulted to nextFriday().

cases.description: LEAP calls add — must recognise long-dated expiry from 'Leap' keyword
PCS with 'Long' prefix — direction must be SHORT (selling credit spread)
cases.notes: PCS = credit spread = SHORT direction. 'Long' is stock view not trade direction.

cases.description: 'Exit NFLX with .12 loss per contract (15)' — loss-per-contract exit must close, not be skipped

input.message: Exit NFLX with .12 loss per contract (15)

cases.notes: Bug: system auto-closed at expiry ($0.00) because this exit at 3:43 PM was not recognised as a CLOSE. '(15)' is the original contract count, not a quantity instruction. 'with .12 loss per contract' is exit context, not a SKIP trigger.

cases.description: 'sold' overrides 'Long' prefix — cash-secured put is SHORT direction

input.message: Long BE sold Oct $59 put $2.40. Happy to own the stock below AVWAP

cases.notes: 'sold' is authoritative over 'Long' prefix. Happy to own = cash-secured put.

cases.description: LEAP add-on with 'Short' badge + explicit expiry/strike — badge is view, not direction

input.message: Short SPY - added another 10 the leaps - total 60 - avg. $27.67 - 3/26 - $600

cases.notes: Bug: v10 classified as SHORT STOCK. 'Short' badge is bearish VIEW. 'added another 10 the leaps' = LONG CALL. '3/26' = March 2026 expiry, '$600' = strike. System created SPY 250926C00660000 (next-Friday fallback) and auto-closed 2 days later.

cases.description: 'Long UNH cds for next week expiration' — expiry hint leg required, not next-Friday default

input.message: Long UNH cds for next week expiration

cases.notes: Bug: LLM omitted legs entirely → system defaulted to nextFriday(2025-09-19) = same-day expiry. Need hint leg with expiry 'next week' and strike: 0.

cases.description: 'Long UNH added some straight oct 3 calls' — expiry hint leg for month+day format

input.message: Long UNH added some straight oct 3 calls

cases.notes: Bug: LLM omitted legs → system defaulted to nextFriday(2025-09-19) = same-day expiry. Need hint leg with expiry 'oct 3' and strike: 0.

cases.description: 'Short C Lotto weeklies $95.50 puts' — 'weeklies' expiry must be parseable, not crash normalizeExpiry

input.message: Short C Lotto weeklies $95.50 puts for .15

cases.notes: Bug: LLM emitted expiry 'weekly' which crashed normalizeExpiry. Lotto = LONG (buy). 'Weeklies' = short-dated weekly option expiry.
